description: Style values by a scale given once: each target's value picks its step, whose fill and text colour it gets (documents: a character style per step, cell shading; decks: direct). check with scale finds values styled wrong.

preview.description: Report each value's step, change nothing.

scale.description: Steps given once, and the values they style.

name.description: Names the styles: Score -> Score 1 Low. Default Step.

show.description: label: the text becomes its step's label, the value kept; check flags labels not their value's.

steps.description: Lowest first: each a min, or each a value.

max.description: Highest value; above it, to the next min, no step.

min.description: Lowest value; the step runs to the next min.

text.description: Text colour; auto: white or black, more contrast.

value.description: Or the one value or text it takes.

targets.description: Paragraphs, ranges, shapes, cells; a table's column (/col1); {{d:x/*/y}} written values.

name: style_by_value
